name: node-control
description: Use this skill when writing or changing what a node runs. It says whether a node is controlled through code, through grammar or not at all, how Python code returns data to pass it on, how code reads each input through an input chip, a column chip or a layer chip, how a tuple hands on several values, what a grammar node hands on, and how a Vega-Lite spec reads its inputs: the first with no data field, another by naming its dataset.
